column1: 区画を 1 つずつ組んで、そのたびに電源を入れて確かめます。おかしな所があっても、いま付けた区画の数個の部品を見れば済みます。電源の入口の区画から順に並べ、区画の中は背の低い部品から (コネクタ・リレーは最後)。電源を入れる前に、テスターの抵抗レンジで電源の線と GND がショートしていないことを確かめ、電流を制限できる電源で入れます。

Sections are ordered from the supply input, and within a section from the lowest parts (connectors and relays last). Before powering up, check with the multimeter's resistance range that the supply line and GND are not shorted, and use a supply that can limit the current.

column1: 銅の帯が横に並んだ基板 (ストリップ基板) に組む並べ方です。IC の段の上と下に帯の組があり、1 本ずつ 1 つのネットです (左に名前)。2 本足の部品は、つなぐ 2 つの帯をまたいで縦に差します。IC は × の穴で帯を切って足ごとに分け、上半分の足は上の帯へ、下半分の足は下の帯へ色の線でつなぎます。同じネットの帯どうしは左の線でつなぎます。帯を切るのは、裏から穴の銅を削ります (ドリルの刃を手で回す・専用のカッター)
column2: A layout for a board with horizontal copper strips (stripboard). There are groups of strips above and below the IC row, each strip one net (name on the left). Two-lead parts go in vertically across the two strips they connect. Strips are cut at the × holes to separate each IC lead; the upper leads connect to the upper strips and the lower leads to the lower strips with colored wires. Strips of the same net are joined by the wires on the left. To cut a strip, scrape the copper at the hole from the bottom (turn a drill bit by hand, or use a strip cutter)

column1: 穴だけの基板 (ユニバーサル基板) に組む並べ方です。帯が無いので、部品はつなぐ相手の近くに置き (長いヘッダは上の縁に寝かせて)、ネットごとに灰色の線 (すずめっき線) を裏で縦・横にまっすぐはんだ付けします。ほかのネットの線とは触れません。裏で通れない所は、色の線 (表を通すビニール線) で飛び越えます
column2: A layout for a board with holes only (perfboard). With no strips, parts are placed near what they connect to (long headers lying along the top edge), and for each net gray lines (tinned wire) are soldered straight, vertical or horizontal, on the bottom. They don't touch wires of other nets. Where the bottom has no path, a colored line (insulated wire on top) jumps over

column1: 部品を役割で分けた案を出します: デジタル (信号の半分以上が SPI・I²C・D22 のようなデジタルの線の IC とヘッダ)・リレー (K1 …)・アナログ・電源 (レギュレータ)。抵抗やコンデンサは、いちばんつながっている組へ、電源だけにつながるものは回路図で近くに描いた IC の組へ入れます。役割が 1 つしか無い回路は、間をつなぐネットが少ない所で分けます (電源と GND のネットは数えません)。ネットの名前で役割を決めるので、案を見てから区画にします
column2: Suggests groups of parts by role: digital (ICs and headers with more than half of their signals on digital lines such as SPI, I²C, D22), relays (K1 …), analog, and power (regulators). Resistors and capacitors go to the group they connect to most; those connected only to supplies go to the group of the IC drawn nearby in the schematic. A circuit with only one role is split where few nets connect the parts (supply and GND nets are not counted). Roles are decided from net names, so review the suggestion before making sections

column1: 0805・1206 のチップ抵抗・チップコンデンサを、裏 (はんだの面) で隣り合う 2 つの穴にまたがせてはんだ付けする並べ方にします。ユニバーサル基板では、片方の端を、つなぐ IC の足の穴に一緒にはんだ付けできるので、プルアップやパスコンを足のすぐそばに置けて、表の部品と線が減り、基板が小さくなります。ストリップ基板では、つなぐ 2 つのネットの帯が上下に隣り合う所にまたがせます (そういう所が無いチップは表のまま。全部を表にした並べ方より小さくならないときは、全部を表にした並べ方にします)。小さいチップを手ではんだ付けするのに慣れた人向けです (初めてなら、同じ値のリード部品を表に付ける今の形で)。リード部品は裏に付けません
column2: Lays out 0805 and 1206 chip resistors and capacitors soldered on the bottom (solder side), bridging two neighboring holes. On perfboard, one end can be soldered into the hole of the IC lead it connects to, so pull-ups and decoupling capacitors sit right by the lead, with fewer parts and wires on top and a smaller board. On stripboard, chips bridge spots where the strips of the two nets they connect are next to each other vertically (chips with no such spot stay on top; if the result isn't smaller than the all-top layout, the all-top layout is used). For people used to hand-soldering small chips (if it's your first time, keep the current form with leaded parts of the same value on top). Leaded parts are not put on the bottom

column1: 回路図・基板の「選択」と同じ (ほかの道具からは Esc か右クリックで戻ります)。部品や線の端を穴ごとにドラッグして動かします。回路図と同じく、何も無い所から左ドラッグで囲むと囲んだ部品を、右ドラッグで触れた部品も選び (Shift で今の選択に足す・Shift + クリックで 1 個ずつ足す・外す)、選んだ部品のどれかをドラッグすると、まとめて動きます (囲んだ所の線の端・切る穴も一緒に)。R で選んだ部品をまとめて回します (ストリップ基板は半回転: 帯は横のままなので、中のつながりは変わりません。ユニバーサル基板は 90°)。選んだ部品は R で回り (2 本足は立てる ↔ 寝かせる、IC はストリップ基板では向きを逆に、ユニバーサル基板では 90°)、選んだ線 (表の線・裏のすずめっき線をクリック) は Delete で消えます。囲んでから Delete を押すと、囲んだ中の線をまとめて消します
column2: Same as "Select" in the schematic and board (from other tools, Esc or right-click comes back). Drag parts and wire ends hole by hole. As in the schematic, left-drag from an empty spot selects the enclosed parts and right-drag also the touched parts (Shift adds to the current selection, Shift + click adds or removes one at a time); dragging any selected part moves them all (with the wire ends and cut holes in the box). R rotates the selected parts together (half a turn on stripboard: the strips stay horizontal, so the connections inside don't change; 90° on perfboard). A selected part rotates with R (two-lead parts switch between standing and lying, ICs reverse on stripboard and turn 90° on perfboard), and a selected wire (click a top wire or a bottom tinned wire) is removed with Delete. Box-select and press Delete to remove all wires inside the box

Click a hole, then a hole in the same row or column, or at 45° (at 45° it passes through the middle of the holes on the way). A wire that would cross another diagonal wire on the same side between holes can't be drawn (bare wires would touch and short). Both ends of the wire connect, as do holes on the way where it overlaps a part's lead or another wire on the same side. Use the "Delete" tool to remove one. Right-click or Esc stops a wire in progress
